id.description: its asset ID (format 0.8): ten random symbols of Crockford's base32 and a check symbol, 4-4-3 (7K2Q-XM9F-4DP), of no project or place: carried anywhere, it keeps it
id.title: Id

ItemLocal.description:
Where an item stands in its building's own frame: what it is placed by. The
building's position on the map never changes it.

x_m.description: metres from the origin of the building's drawings, along their x
x_m.title: X M

y_m.description: metres from the origin of the building's drawings, along their y
y_m.title: Y M

rotation_deg.description: the way its front faces, in degrees counter-clockwise: 0 the drawings' -y, 90 their +x
rotation_deg.title: Rotation Deg

ItemLocal.title: ItemLocal

type.description: the item's type: a code of catalogue.json (DESK-MANAGER, COPIER, …)
type.title: Type

category.description: its type's category (format 0.10): what it is for, of the catalogue's
category.title: Category

name.description: its type's English name, for readers that do not read the catalogue
name.title: Name

floor_id.description: the floor it stands on, or (format 0.12) the layout of the land it stands on
floor_id.title: Floor Id

building_id.description: the building it stands in; null for one on a location's land (format 0.12: its floor_id is the layout)
building_id.title: Building Id

space_id.description: the space it stands in (null: in none of them)
space_id.title: Space Id

zone_id.description: the zone it stands in, when its space is divided
zone_id.title: Zone Id

local.description: where it stands in its building (format 0.7): its middle and turn in the building's own frame, unchanged when the building moves on the map; the footprint, display_point and heading follow from it and the building's placement. On a location's land (format 0.12): in the site's frame

heading.description: the way its front faces: degrees clockwise from north
heading.title: Heading

elevation_m.description: how high above the floor its bottom is (null for one on the ceiling: just under it)
elevation_m.title: Elevation M

values.description: its details entered in StoreyPath, by the catalogue's field keys (the others belong to the system that manages the asset)
values.title: Values

group.description: the items placed or grouped together with it (format 0.10: a workstation's desk, chair and pedestal; a meeting table and its chairs): a key its group's items share and no other item of the package has; null: in none. A group is a link, not an asset
group.title: Group

door_id.description: the door it serves (format 0.10: a card reader, a door controller, an exit button, of a type that serves_door): an opening of its floor, a door or an opening, never a window; null: none
door_id.title: Door Id

view_deg.description: a camera's view (format 0.10: of a type of shape camera): how wide it sees, degrees across, about the way its front faces (360: all round); its own, else its type's; null: not a camera, or not known
view_deg.title: View Deg

range_m.description: a camera's view: how far it sees, metres from it; its own, else its type's; null as view_deg
range_m.title: Range M
